source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Inject the EpiPen into the buttock because the gluteal muscle provides the preferred absorption site for the auto-injector.","B":"Inject the EpiPen into a hand or foot when the thigh is not immediately accessible because distal sites are equivalent.","C":"Inject the EpiPen dose into the anterolateral thigh; administration through clothing is acceptable when necessary in an emergency.","D":"Inject the EpiPen directly into a vein because intravenous administration is the routine intended route for this auto-injector."}}
source_row.rationale: EpiPen labeling directs injection into the anterolateral thigh, through clothing if necessary, and warns against injection into the buttock, digits, hands, feet or intravenously.
